reason: is_safe_url calls strip_control_chars(url).strip() before validating, so embedded or trailing control bytes (e.g. '\n', '\t', '\x00') are silently removed and the URL is accepted instead of rejected as Req 1 requires. sanitize_markdown_link inherits the same stripping. The three passing tests never exercise control-character input to is_safe_url, so the green pytest result does not cover this requirement. Fix: reject any URL containing ord<32, ord==127, or whitespace before parsing, and add tests for such inputs, including a data: URL.
